rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when singing or playing sounds musically poor or unpleasant.

example.english: I sing unmusically, and even the neighbour’s dog walks away.
example.traditional: 我唱歌唱得唔好聽，連隔籬屋隻狗都走開。
example.jyutping: ngo5 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dak1 m4 hou2 teng1 lin4 gaak3 lei4 uk1 zek3 gau2 dou1 zau2 hoi1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the performance goes out of tune rather than merely sounding bad.

example.english: I sing unmusically and even I can’t bear listening to it.
example.traditional: 我唱到走音，連自己都聽唔落。
example.jyutping: ngo5 coeng3 dou3 zau2 jam1 lin4 zi6 gei2 dou1 teng1 m4 lok6
